metaDescription: Order custom polyester lanyards in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Durable, comfortable, and perfect for your next event or promotion.
introHtml: Polyester lanyards offer a balance of durability and affordability, making them a go-to choice for conferences, trade shows, and daily ID badge use. The material resists fraying and holds vibrant screen-printed logos well, as seen in options like the 5/8" Neon Polyester Lanyard or the 3/4" Silkscreened Flat Lanyard. For safety managers and HR directors needing a reliable, comfortable neck strap that won't irritate skin, polyester provides a practical solution that keeps your branding visible all day.
heroAltText: Custom polyester lanyards with colorful screen-printed logos and metal clips for ID badges
